limitations: Full semantic evaluator replay is outside this bounded review and remains UNEXECUTED on every graph.
After the first actual refusal, later laws are notReached (not silent passes).
This is not whole-consumer ACCEPT and does not discharge the original 134 reconstruction obligations.
Rust graphs never reached fact/coverage/clones/partial-ownership laws because native context admission refused first.
Capability-manifest ADM gates and some execution-input cell-outcome derivations were notReached on graphs that failed earlier.

Component TreeCommitment projection is executed when platforms[].tree is present on retained manifest bytes; detached signature envelope verification is operational/future (S1 says this is not a second signature verifier).
No truth comparison of claimed vs independently replayed proof was treated as a structural law.
The logical-result tamper graph was not compared for false verdict as a structural check; it refused earlier on the same subset law as its untampered sibling.
